China injects billions into financial sector to boost growth

Beijing is injecting billions of dollars into its banks and insurers as part of a plan to boost economic growth. The move aims to strengthen the financial sector and improve its performance. This recapitalization effort includes state-controlled institutions. The specific amount mentioned is $53 billion.
